task_instance: Run the developer-growth-analysis end to end: read recent Claude Code chat history, identify improvement areas, generate a personalized growth report, curate HackerNews learning resources for each area, and deliver the report to the user's own Slack DMs. A sample history.jsonl was created as realistic input.
blocker_detail: The skill's core deliverable integrally requires two network/service steps that cannot run on an air-gapped workstation: (1) curating learning resources from the HackerNews service, and (2) sending the finished report to the user's Slack direct messages. Both are performed through the Rube MCP connector (RUBE_SEARCH_TOOLS / RUBE_MULTI_EXECUTE_TOOL / RUBE_MANAGE_CONNECTIONS), which needs outbound network and an authenticated Slack account. The runtime has no network, and MCP/connector calls are also disallowed by the safety rules. The offline-achievable steps (read history, analyze patterns, identify improvement areas, generate the report body) were completed and verified, but the HackerNews-curation and Slack-delivery halves of the stated deliverable are blocked.
evidence: Work dir /tmp/claude-0/-home-user/b273891e-4b73-5af7-9840-fc512af93809/scratchpad/real2_work/r099. Confirmed ~/.claude/history.jsonl absent, so created a 6-entry sample history.jsonl as input. Ran a python3 analysis that filtered to the past 48h, tallied recurring themes (3 null-check/undefined mentions, an un-awaited promise, a TS union struggle, a full-table-scan SQL query) and wrote growth_report.md (1806 bytes) containing Work Summary, 3 prioritized Improvement Areas, Strengths, and Action Items. Verified by reading back the report header. The 'Curated Learning Resources' section could only be stubbed as [BLOCKED] because HackerNews search requires the Rube connector over the network, and step 7 (Slack DM delivery) likewise requires the Rube connector plus an authenticated Slack account over the network; neither is reachable offline and both are additionally forbidden by the no-MCP/no-network safety rules.
